scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Iconic Mother
other_conditions: Must have raised children who have achieved notable success in society
Must have worked for the protection, promotion and empowerment of the girl child
Must have received wide recognition from society for the contribution
Nomination must be submitted in writing by an authorized nominating agency or individual
benefits_summary: The award includes a citation, a memento and a cash prize of ₹2,50,000, with travel, lodging and DA/TA expenses covered for the awardee and one companion.
